name: PW Loyalty Points and Rewards for WooCommerce
author: pimwick

sections.description:
Effortless Setup. Instant Rewards.

From the creators of PW WooCommerce Gift Cards, backed by years of expertise in WooCommerce development and retail success, comes a loyalty plugin designed to drive results.

Finally, a loyalty plugin that’s easy to use!

Crafted from the ground up for simplicity and flexibility. Perfect for both you and your customers. Start rewarding loyalty in minutes with a familiar, user-friendly interface used by leading loyalty programs globally.

Grow your business, one loyal customer at a time.

Enhance customer retention, increase repeat purchases, and boost revenue by rewarding your loyal customers. Begin building a steady stream of repeat revenue with ease.

  • User-Friendly Interface: Customize your loyalty program to fit your shop’s unique style.
  • Engaging Customer Offers: Drive purchases with custom offers, including sign-up bonuses for new members.
  • Flexible Admin Control: Easily manage points, with clean HTML and CSS for compatibility across themes and plugins.
  • Seamless WooCommerce Integration: Works with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and WooCommerce Blocks for Cart and Checkout.
  • Mobile-Optimized: A responsive Rewards dashboard for on-the-go customer engagement.
  • International Support: Capable of being translated into any language.

Unlock the full potential of your loyalty program with PW Loyalty Points and Rewards for WooCommerce Pro:

  • Targeted Promotions: Reward customers for specific products or categories with 2X points or bonus points.
  • Easy Offer Organization: Organize offers into categories for quick access and customer convenience.
  • Boosted Engagement: Use point multipliers, bonus points for product reviews, and birthday bonuses to keep customers coming back.
  • Automatic Expiration and Scheduling: Set expiration dates for points, schedule offers, and limit usage for more control.
  • Additional Rewards Options: Include percentage discounts, free products, timed bonuses, and custom point settings for each product or category.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/pw-loyalty-points-and-rewards-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Pimwick Plugins > PW Rewards
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with currency switchers?

Yes, you can use many currency switchers with this plugin. However, we recommend testing your specific setup to ensure compatibility.
